segments.ja417:1.1: Odātavatthā suci allakesā, kaccāni kiṃ kumbhimadhissayitvā [kumbhimapassayitvā (pī.)];
segments.ja417:1.3: Piṭṭhā tilā dhovasi taṇḍulāni, tilodano hehiti kissa hetu.
segments.ja417:2.1: Na kho ayaṃ brāhmaṇa bhojanatthā [bhojanatthaṃ (syā.)], tilodano hehiti sādhupakko;
segments.ja417:2.3: Dhammo mato tassa pahuttamajja [pahūnamajja (syā.), pahūtamajja (sī.), bahūtamajjā (pī.)], ahaṃ karissāmi susānamajjhe.
segments.ja417:3.1: Anuvicca kaccāni karohi kiccaṃ, dhammo mato ko nu taveva [taveta (sī. syā. pī.)] saṃsi;
segments.ja417:3.3: Sahassanetto atulānubhāvo, na miyyatī dhammavaro kadāci.
segments.ja417:4.1: Daḷhappamāṇaṃ mama ettha brahme, dhammo mato natthi mamettha kaṅkhā;
segments.ja417:4.3: Ye yeva dāni pāpā bhavanti, te teva dāni sukhitā bhavanti.
segments.ja417:5.1: Suṇisā hi mayhaṃ vañjhā ahosi, sā maṃ vadhitvāna vijāyi puttaṃ;
segments.ja417:5.3: Sā dāni sabbassa kulassa issarā, ahaṃ panamhi [vasāmi (syā.)] apaviddhā ekikā.
segments.ja417:6.1: Jīvāmi vohaṃ na matohamasmi [nāhaṃ matosmi (sī. pī.)], taveva atthāya idhāgatosmi;
segments.ja417:6.3: Yā taṃ vadhitvāna vijāyi puttaṃ, sahāva puttena karomi bhasmaṃ.
segments.ja417:7.1: Evañca [etañca (sī. pī.)] te ruccati devarāja, mameva atthāya idhāgatosi;
segments.ja417:7.3: Ahañca putto suṇisā ca nattā, sammodamānā gharamāvasema.
segments.ja417:8.1: Evañca te ruccati kātiyāni, hatāpi santā na jahāsi dhammaṃ;
segments.ja417:8.3: Tuvañca [tvañca (pī. ka.)] putto suṇisā ca nattā, sammodamānā gharamāvasetha.
segments.ja417:9.1: Sā kātiyānī suṇisāya saddhiṃ, sammodamānā gharamāvasittha;
segments.ja417:9.3: Putto ca nattā ca upaṭṭhahiṃsu, devānamindena adhiggahītāti.

lines: Tattha kaccānīti taṃ gottena ālapati.
Kumbhimadhissayitvāti pacanathālikaṃ manussasīsuddhanaṃ āropetvā.
Hehitīti ayaṃ tilodano kissa hetu bhavissati, kiṃ attanā bhuñjissasi, udāhu aññaṃ kāraṇamatthīti.
Athassa sā ācikkhantī dutiyaṃ gāthamāha –
“Na kho ayaṃ brāhmaṇa bhojanatthā, tilodano hehiti sādhupakko;
Dhammo mato tassa pahuttamajja, ahaṃ karissāmi susānamajjhe”ti.
Tattha dhammoti jeṭṭhāpacāyanadhammo ceva tividhasucaritadhammo ca.
Tassa pahuttamajjāti tassāhaṃ dhammassa idaṃ matakabhattaṃ karissāmīti attho.
Tato sakko tatiyaṃ gāthamāha –
“Anuvicca kaccāni karohi kiccaṃ, dhammo mato ko nu taveva saṃsi;
Sahassanetto atulānubhāvo, na miyyatī dhammavaro kadācī”ti.
Tattha anuviccāti upaparikkhitvā jānitvā.
Ko nu taveva saṃsīti ko nu tava evaṃ ācikkhi.
Sahassanettoti attānaṃ dhammavaraṃ uttamadhammaṃ katvā dassento evamāha.
Taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā itarā dve gāthā abhāsi –
“Daḷhappamāṇaṃ mama ettha brahme, dhammo mato natthi mamettha kaṅkhā;
Ye yeva dāni pāpā bhavanti, te teva dāni sukhitā bhavanti.
“Suṇisā hi mayhaṃ vañjhā ahosi, sā maṃ vadhitvāna vijāyi puttaṃ;
Sā dāni sabbassa kulassa issarā, ahaṃ panamhi apaviddhā ekikā”ti.
Tattha daḷhappamāṇanti daḷhaṃ thiraṃ nissaṃsayaṃ brāhmaṇa ettha mama pamāṇanti vadati.
Ye yeti tassa matabhāve kāraṇaṃ dassentī evamāha.
Vadhitvānāti pothetvā nikkaḍḍhitvā.
Apaviddhāti chaḍḍitā anāthā hutvā ekikā vasāmi.
Tato sakko chaṭṭhaṃ gāthamāha –
“Jīvāmi vohaṃ na matohamasmi, taveva atthāya idhāgatosmi;
Yā taṃ vadhitvāna vijāyi puttaṃ, sahāva puttena karomi bhasman”ti.
Tattha voti nipātamattaṃ.
Itarā taṃ sutvā “dhī ahaṃ kiṃ kathesiṃ, mama nattu amaraṇakāraṇaṃ karissāmī”ti sattamaṃ gāthamāha –
“Evañca te ruccati devarāja, mameva atthāya idhāgatosi;
Ahañca putto suṇisā ca nattā, sammodamānā gharamāvasemā”ti.
Athassā sakko aṭṭhamaṃ gāthamāha –
“Evañca te ruccati kātiyāni, hatāpi santā na jahāsi dhammaṃ;
Tuvañca putto suṇisā ca nattā, sammodamānā gharamāvasethā”ti.
Tattha hatāpi santāti yadi tvaṃ pothitāpi nikkaḍḍhitāpi samānā tava dārakesu mettadhammaṃ na jahāsi, evaṃ sante yathā tvaṃ icchasi, tathā hotu, ahaṃ te imasmiṃ guṇe pasannoti.

Evañca pana vatvā alaṅkatapaṭiyatto sakko attano ānubhāvena ākāse ṭhatvā “kaccāni tvaṃ mā bhāyi, putto ca te suṇisā ca mamānubhāvena āgantvā antarāmagge taṃ khamāpetvā ādāya gamissanti, appamattā hohī”ti vatvā attano ṭhānameva gato.

Tepi sakkānubhāvena tassā guṇaṃ anussaritvā “kahaṃ no mātā”ti antogāme manusse pucchitvā “susānābhimukhaṃ gatā”ti sutvā “amma, ammā”ti susānamaggaṃ paṭipajjitvā taṃ disvāva pādesu patitvā “amma, amhākaṃ dosaṃ khamāhī”ti taṃ khamāpesuṃ.
Sāpi nattāraṃ gaṇhi.
Iti te sammodamānā gehaṃ gantvā tato paṭṭhāya samaggavāsaṃ vasiṃsu.
“Sā kātiyānī suṇisāya saddhiṃ, sammodamānā gharamāvasittha;
Putto ca nattā ca upaṭṭhahiṃsu, devānamindena adhiggahītā”ti.
Ayaṃ abhisambuddhagāthā.
Tattha sā kātiyānīti bhikkhave, sā kaccānagottā.
Devānamindena adhiggahītāti devindena sakkena anuggahitā hutvā tassānubhāvena samaggavāsaṃ vasiṃsūti.
